text: I can classify a list of alert rules as symptoms or causes and rewrite cause-based pages as symptom-based ones tied to the SLO.
I can name the cause alerts that still justify a page (predictable cliffs like a disk filling within hours) and write one with predict_linear.
I can sort alerts into page, ticket and dashboard using the urgent, actionable, user-visible and requires-intelligence tests.
I can configure Alertmanager grouping and inhibition so one failed dependency produces one notification, and explain the risk inhibition adds.
I can write a runbook with impact, confirmation, ordered mitigations, escalation and an owner, and spot when it should be automation instead.
